6eeef75f67b0.identity: loopBeAudio 1.2 / nerds.de Audio LoopBack Monitor host infected with a native polymorphic PE infector; collected ransomware family labels are unproven
recovery: Entry VA 0x526434 executes opaque arithmetic/branches, reaches inline XOR decoder at 0x526536. The call at 0x52654b supplies 59 bytes at 0x526550; key 0x5f. Decoded code preserves its pointer through MMX and transfers into executable .rsrc.

At 0x5cba44 a call/pop decoder reads state, multiplier and length from its own parameter block. It multiplies state, adds 19 via SUB EAX,-19, rotates left by three, XORs each byte and feeds plaintext back into state. Decodes 0xa177 bytes.

Decoded loader at 0x5ccb27 walks the PEB and kernel export table for GetProcAddress; resolves VirtualAlloc, Beep and LoadLibraryA. It locates the last section tail, copies and RC4-decrypts a 0x8c00-byte PE using an eight-byte tail key.

Manual mapper copies PE headers and sections, applies HIGHLOW relocations, resolves imports and calls DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH. The payload restores stolen host entry bytes through ExecuteTrampoline; loader resumes the original host.
reachable_effects: DLL entry 0x6240d1ed starts downloader, temp cleaner, infection scanner, drive autorun and Run-key scanner workers before ExecuteTrampoline.

InfectFile at 0x624054fe opens and maps target executables, emits encrypted/metamorphic stages, rewrites entry code and section/image headers, sets RWX, clears ASLR/NX/security-directory fields, flushes mappings and restores timestamps (SetFileTime at 0x62406750).

CreateAutoRun at 0x6240cbf2 prepares executable packages on drives. CreateProtectedAutorun at 0x6240c91e writes generated autorun.inf open/explore/autoplay commands, hides/protects the files and locks them.
RegScanThread at 0x624074b8 READS HKCU Run values and infects referenced executables via InfectFile at 0x624076ce; no evidence of a Run-key write.

DownloadAndUpdate at 0x624010c2 resolves updatewin.ddns.net, connects on TCP 8000, exchanges DOWNLOAD/READY messages, receives bounded payload data, writes a random temporary executable, checks the written size and launches that same path with CreateProcessW at 0x624015aa.
CleanAllUsersTemp at 0x624015f5 enumerates user profiles and their AppData\Local\Temp directories, enumerates *.exe and *.rar, and deletes matching files at 0x62401872/0x62401933.
6eeef75f67b0.judgment: Unauthorized executable infection, drive navigation hijacking, and downloaded payload activation are decisive. The original audio monitor identity does not explain these paths. No Windows execution or C2 response was required or observed.
6eeef75f67b0.coverage_gap: Outer original remains below the 3-5 hostile goal (one hostile). Existing five hostile payload rules match the manually recovered DLL, but original ciphertext does not expose those bytes. Cleave metamorphic_graft.rs DECODER hardcodes LEA EAX,[EAX+19], whereas original uses equivalent SUB EAX,-19. An equivalent LEA control exposes the exact same DLL and UPX child (both child nodes have five hostile findings), confirming an engine extraction gap beyond YAML. Original SUB variant is now detected by the generalized YAML atom and existing parasitic-entry objective. No duplicate ciphertext-level claims were invented.
6eeef75f67b0.additional_gap: Generic deletion coverage is retained; no path-bound hostile rule yet captures the entire cross-user Temp executable/archive purge. Native directory/path/delete calls were traced, but co-occurrence of these strings and DeleteFile alone would overstate the targeted relationship.

85bcf196bd01.identity: @accordproject/markdown-it-cicero 1.1.0; sample filename omits the scope but package manifest and registry identify it correctly
paths: lib/index.js exports a markdown-it plugin registering inline and block parser rules and render callbacks. Local imports load regex helpers, block parser and renderer; there is no install hook.
cicero_block recognizes balanced clause delimiters and recursively tokenizes their contents. cicero_inline stores formula text in tokens; it does not evaluate the formula as JavaScript.

formula_inline interpolates token.content into a span without escaping; the existing object-field-in-html-body-markup finding accurately records that rendering behavior. Possible HTML injection is a vulnerability concern, not evidence of an intentionally malicious payload.
cicero_re constructs bounded anchored expression patterns and validates allowed block names against names.json. Source maps and declarations align with the emitted code.
85bcf196bd01.provenance: Forager npm retrieval exactly matches the submitted SHA-256. Upstream README corroborates plugin behavior; runtime dependency markdown-it 14.1.0 was fetched, its manifest and parser sources inspected (no install hooks or network/process execution). No exact lockfile is provided.
85bcf196bd01.label_explanation: No deliberate malicious path was found. Unescaped formula HTML rendering or inherited package/container reputation could explain an automated hostile label; the actual upstream labeling rationale is unavailable. Existing notable HTML rendering, regex construction and package facts are retained.

paths: Module entry exports generators, TypeScript/configuration helpers and devkit utilities; there is no install hook.

Node executor resolves configured build targets, waits for build completion, forks a local loader with the selected output path and module mappings, relays stdout/stderr, and terminates/restarts the process tree during watch mode.

Loader new Function helpers implement dynamic import for the selected workspace file. CommonJS override maps workspace package names to build output; ESM loader registers the corresponding local resolver.
Release publish reads workspace manifests, checks package-manager state, queries npm versions/dist-tags, and publishes the configured package; dry-run flags are honored.
Verdaccio executor starts the installed registry, temporarily changes npm/yarn registry and token configuration for the selected local endpoint, and restores configuration during cleanup.
TypeScript plugin reads tsconfigs/package graphs and builds inferred targets and cache inputs. Other generators write project files and invoke declared build/install tools.
88095a3bebba.provenance: Forager retrieved the same version from registry.npmjs.org with an exact SHA-256 match. All 29 declared runtime dependencies were fetched at pinned versions (range lower bounds where no lockfile supplied): matching prerelease @nx/devkit/@nx/workspace plus 27 compiler/parser/build libraries. Their manifests and sources were reviewed, including devkit package-install and workspace npm-query execution paths. No install hooks or added hostile paths were found. Review does not establish every possible future resolution or the full transitive closure.
88095a3bebba.urls: Manifest/README point to nrwl/nx, nx.dev and upstream development documentation. The historical nx.dev/js/overview reference returned 404 through forager; canonical registry tarball verification and source analysis supply identity. No runtime remote payload URL was found.
88095a3bebba.false_positive: Root README advertises nx/@nx/workspace siblings and a monorepo-wide title; release bursts are expected for coordinated prereleases. This is not foreign clone provenance. A narrow documentation relationship now excludes the pre-existing official Nx scope/repository pairing; raw heading/link/cadence facts and all executable behavior findings remain.
88095a3bebba.label_explanation: The clone heuristic plus powerful build/process/registry operations plausibly caused the hostile-source label. Package bytes are official and behavior serves a build plugin. Actual source-label rationale and machine deployment context are unavailable.

rule_changes.change: Accept SUB immediate alongside existing LEA and ADD state updates while retaining multiplication, rotation, XOR, plaintext feedback and execution transfer; no old alternative removed.
Add a neutral publication/documentation relationship using existing heading/link/manifest facts, with the existing official Nx pairing as a narrow exclusion.

Consume that relationship before inferring clone provenance from registry cadence. No payload rules or severity demotions. An initial attempt to extend the broad shared exception list exceeded suppression budgets; final implementation keeps the Nx relationship qualification local.

coverage_preservation.positive_outside_batch: Forager recovered 74ef3a48c097b0464287592c0f3bcaefbeafb0cb8980633075280be886a2c53c; all prior hostile/suspicious findings retained. Existing TeamPCP Nx bootstrap remains hostile. Existing foreign-heading/foreign-link clones and newly renamed/wrong-repository controls retain clone detection.
coverage_preservation.near_misses: Missing inline execution, missing feedback, and nonexecutable resource controls do not match the parasitic objective; ADD/LEA/SUB variants do. Official Nx documentation is excluded from cloning.
coverage_preservation.material_losses: Only the unsupported Nx clone finding was removed from submitted samples. Per-member before/after comparisons found no other detection losses.

classifier_disagreement: All submitted originals retain calibrated ML level -1 (benign), despite probabilities recorded above. This misses the malicious infector even after its hostile YAML finding. The separately recovered DLL has five hostile findings and is also analyzed separately; scores are not verdict evidence. Model v18.18 warns of feature-spec 18 versus 21. Nx remains benign by review despite increased ML probability after removing the inaccurate clone claim.
validation: Required final action: make validate; actual result is reported in the final response.
